doc_title: APPLICATION FOR REGISTRATION OF AN INHIBITION ORDER
doc_title_official: APPLICATION FOR REGISTRATION OF AN INHIBITION ORDER
when_used: A person in whose favour a court has made an inhibition order applies to have the order registered against the title, attaching a sealed copy of it.

detail_rows.label: The Applicant: Give full name(s) ID/Passport number and address. if corporate include the registered number, as well as address for service in Kenya
Court Order Give details of the Case Number and parties

body_text.text: The Applicant HEREBY APPLIES for the registration of the above Court Order issued on the {{order_date}} in respect of the above mentioned land.
A copy of the Court Order duly sealed is attached.
